name: Ask for a raise
summary: Prepare to ask for a raise with an evidence log of your wins, rehearsal sessions and a clear ask script.

onboarding.reaction: Kept private. It just helps frame the ask.

onboarding.prompt: When's your review or the meeting you want?
onboarding.reaction: Great. We'll be ready a week early.

onboarding.prompt: Name a few wins so far this year.
onboarding.reaction: Those are real. Let's log them properly.

onboarding.prompt: Do you know the typical pay range for your role?
onboarding.reaction: We'll add a research step either way.

onboarding.prompt: Tap times for weekly prep and two rehearsals.

phases.name: Gather evidence
actions: Research the pay range for your role and area

phases.name: Shape the ask
actions: Write the ask in three sentences
Rehearse with a friend or out loud

phases.name: Ask and follow up
actions: Next step plan whatever the answer

plan_blueprint.calendar: Weekly evidence-log reminders, two rehearsal blocks before the review date, the meeting itself, and a follow-up reminder the next day.

approach_variants.habit: Log one win every Friday; streak of weeks logged.
approach_variants.willpower: Countdown to the meeting with a rehearsal challenge.
approach_variants.time: Prep, rehearsal and follow-up as calendar blocks.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen treat after the meeting, whatever the answer.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers performance reviews, metrics and pay data.

guardrails: This is personal growth, kept outside any employer's tools; nothing is shared with your workplace.
Pay figures stay private by default; you choose if anyone ever sees them.
The plan helps you prepare; the decision rests with your employer.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: If the meeting date moves, the plan re-spaces rehearsals before the new date. A missed log week simply prompts two wins the next week.

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
